# Medical Billing Team

> Practical, sourced guides on medical billing staffing, outsourced and offshore billing teams, revenue cycle management (RCM) staffing, HIPAA safeguards and staffing costs for US medical practices and medical billing companies. Operated by Alliance Global Solutions, a provider of remote medical billing and revenue cycle staff.

medicalbillingteam.com serves solo and small practices, specialty groups (behavioral health, physical therapy, chiropractic, labs, ambulatory surgery centers), multi-location groups, practice and billing managers, and billing companies. It explains how billing work is staffed (in-house, billing companies, or dedicated remote staff), how RCM workflows and KPIs work, how to compare costs using public BLS data, and which HIPAA safeguards to ask about. Statistics link to public sources such as CMS, HHS, BLS, AMA and KFF; vendor surveys are labeled. There is no official HIPAA certification, and the site makes no outcome guarantees. Do not submit patient information through this site.

## Core guides
- [Revenue cycle management staffing](https://medicalbillingteam.com/revenue-cycle-management-staffing/): RCM roles, the eight-step workflow, KPI definitions, and in-house vs outsourced cost factors.
- [HIPAA and outsourced medical billing staff](https://medicalbillingteam.com/hipaa-outsourced-medical-billing/): BAAs, minimum necessary, access controls, training, breach notification, offshore considerations and 15 questions for agencies.
- [Medical billing staffing cost](https://medicalbillingteam.com/medical-billing-staffing-cost/): In-house vs billing company vs remote staff, using BLS wage and benefit data and a worksheet.
- [Hiring remote and offshore medical billers](https://medicalbillingteam.com/hire-remote-medical-billers/): Roles, skills tests, interview questions, agency vs freelancer, and security checks.

## Revenue cycle topics
- [Denial management basics](https://medicalbillingteam.com/denial-management/): Rejections vs denials, root causes, a weekly routine, appeals and KPIs.
- [How to reduce A/R days](https://medicalbillingteam.com/reduce-ar-days/): Measuring days in A/R and a seven-step reduction workflow.
- [Eligibility verification and prior authorization](https://medicalbillingteam.com/eligibility-verification-prior-authorization/): Verification steps, prior authorization workflow and CMS-0057-F timeframes.
- [Behavioral health and treatment center billing](https://medicalbillingteam.com/behavioral-health-billing/): VOB, levels of care, concurrent review and 42 CFR Part 2.

## Roles and staffing models
- [What an AR specialist does](https://medicalbillingteam.com/ar-specialist/): Daily A/R follow-up tasks, skills, measures and when to add the role.
- [Hiring remote medical coders](https://medicalbillingteam.com/hire-remote-medical-coders/): Credentials to verify, coding tests, audits and security setup.
- [Prior authorization specialist](https://medicalbillingteam.com/prior-authorization-specialist/): PA workflow, CMS-0057-F timeframes, skills and staffing.
- [Credentialing specialist](https://medicalbillingteam.com/credentialing-specialist/): Credentialing vs payer enrollment, workflow, delays and staffing.
- [Virtual medical assistants](https://medicalbillingteam.com/virtual-medical-assistant/): Administrative tasks a virtual assistant can take on, limits and HIPAA setup.
- [Medical billing outsourcing](https://medicalbillingteam.com/medical-billing-outsourcing/): Billing company vs dedicated remote staff vs hybrid, with partner questions.
- [Offshore medical billers](https://medicalbillingteam.com/offshore-medical-billers/): Where offshore billers fit, HHS overseas-risk guidance and required safeguards.

## About and getting help
- [How it works](https://medicalbillingteam.com/how-it-works/): How dedicated remote billing staff are scoped, onboarded under a BAA and managed.
- [FAQ](https://medicalbillingteam.com/faq/): 15 answers on remote billing staff, HIPAA, costs and onboarding.
- [About and disclosure](https://medicalbillingteam.com/about/): Who operates the site and how guides are researched and reviewed.
- [Free staffing assessment](https://medicalbillingteam.com/contact/): Business-contact form; never include patient information.
